gates.text: Truth: no slot relies on a result, customer, testimonial, offer, price, partnership or number that is not in the confirmed facts or cited research. Slots that need a missing fact say so in ownerNote.

Shape: exactly the requested number of slots per channel, only the channels given, every slot has a distinct idea, and no two slots on the same channel fall on the same day unless the cadence requires it.

Safety: no engagement bait, giveaways or contests unless requested, no news, tragedy or politics for reach, and every slot touching an always-ask topic, price, offer, regulated claim or named third party is flagged needsOwner.

anchors.1: Generic themes (Motivation Monday, tips) unrelated to the business's positioning.
anchors.3: Pillars relate to the business but are broad categories (education, community).
anchors.5: 3-4 pillars each tied to a specific value pillar, objection, alternative or trigger, with a stated reason for this week's goal.

anchors.1: Slots are topics, not ideas; a writer would still have to decide what to say.
anchors.3: Most slots name a point, but several could belong to any business in the category.
anchors.5: Every slot names one specific, draftable point that only this business could post, with a strong platform-native hook.

anchors.1: The same idea or format pasted across channels.
anchors.3: Formats differ by channel but some ideas are reused or formats are mismatched to the idea.
anchors.5: Each slot's format suits both the platform and the idea; the week mixes teach, prove, connect and ask in proportion to the goal.

anchors.1: Ignores last week's results, edits and rejections.
anchors.3: Mentions history but the plan doesn't visibly change because of it.
anchors.5: Concrete changes traceable to specific results, owner edits or rejections, or, with no history, a deliberate format test.

anchors.1: The week has no visible link to the growth plan's goal or North Star.
anchors.3: Some slots serve the goal; the ask slots are missing or vague.
anchors.5: The week as a whole moves the North Star, with at least one clear, low-friction next step for ready buyers.
